**Black Condor II (Ryan Kendall) died in *Infinite Crisis* #1 (DC Comics, December 2005).**

I used four retrievals: one search, two page reads that returned content, and one that failed. I did the research directly, without the skill's subagent and file-writing workflow, because that workflow conflicts with your "no shell or local files" constraint.

**Claims and sources**

- Ryan Kendall, the second Black Condor, was killed in *Infinite Crisis* #1. The Wikipedia Black Condor page says so. A search summary of the Comic Vine, DCU Guide and DC Fandom results gives the same issue. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor
- The DCU Guide page cites *Infinite Crisis* #1 as the source for his death, but the page itself doesn't state the issue number explicitly. https://dcuguide.com/Black_Condor_(Ryan_Kendall)
- He was killed by Sinestro while serving with the Freedom Fighters, in an ambush by the Secret Society of Super Villains. Wikipedia and DCU Guide both say Sinestro killed him. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor and https://dcuguide.com/Black_Condor_(Ryan_Kendall)
- The "December 2005" date and the "beam fired by Sinestro" detail come only from a search-result summary. I didn't check them on a page. https://dcuguide.com/Black_Condor_(Ryan_Kendall) and https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Ryan_Kendall_(New_Earth)
- Later appearances are not verified. A search summary says he returned as a Black Lantern in *Blackest Night*. It also says a Prime Earth version was resurrected in *Dark Nights: Death Metal*. I didn't confirm either on a page, and neither changes the answer.

**Caveats:** The question's premise holds. Kendall did die, and in a single identifiable issue. I couldn't read the DC Fandom page, which returned HTTP 402, and I didn't check the comic itself.
